_what: What follows finished work when the person turns it on (src/after-work-review.mjs): the AI that finished it is handed one review job, with the rule blocks below, to keep what the work taught as a reusable method (publish_method, save_tool, learn_workflow) instead of leaving it in one chat. Off unless `on` is true. A review is never itself reviewed.
job: Review the work you just finished (handoff {handoff_id}: {work}). {blocks}Write nothing if nothing is worth keeping, and say so in the result.
blocks: Where it goes: a fact about the person goes in saved instructions or a note, a way of doing a kind of job goes in a method or a saved tool, and a one-off detail goes nowhere.
Lessons are class-level: state what holds for the whole kind of job, never this one run's names, ids or dates.
If a method for this kind of job already exists, patch it instead of making another (find_workflow, find_tool_for_job first).
